criterion_binding.scope: One separately proposed source-name-protected original-six Krikri translation development stage, pending exact execution contract and native setup review. No new sources or acceptance exceptions.
criterion_binding.major_error_rule: Any material omission, invention, role reversal, name substitution, quantity/relationship error, or changed condition blocks quality promotion.

classification_definitions.acceptable: No material semantic error or notable fluency defect observed in the complete output for this case.
classification_definitions.minor_issue: Recoverable wording or grammar defect without a material change of the tested meaning.
classification_definitions.major_error: The unchanged original major-error rule applies; any such finding blocks quality promotion.

criterion_binding.review_policy: Judge complete returned translations for actors, roles, names, quantities, negation, conditions, uncertainty and prose meaning. Lexical indicators flag review only; legitimate localized numbers and consistent name transliterations are permitted. Any unusable, incomplete, limit-stopped or protocol-rejected case remains an execution rejection rather than a successful semantic result. Original source metadata must remain bound.
criterion_binding.source_script_names: Exact original-script genuine personal names are considered under the already frozen source-name criteria/design review; they do not exempt ordinary target-language prose, role/actor relationships or any meaning criterion. This does not regrade the rejected Nick/Helen substitutions.
criterion_binding.source_span_inputs: Only the separately reviewed actual original-six detector outputs and frozen generic boundary rule may derive source-name spans; no reference names or transliteration dictionaries. Their previous rejections and narrow development decisions remain unchanged.
criterion_binding.future_protocol_review: Exact marker generation/collision policy, per-segment counts and ownership, restoration order, source metadata, post-restoration production guard and native complete-request token accounting require concrete review before translation generation.
criterion_binding.candidate_plan_binding: Pending owner-supplied frozen plan; this file freezes only unchanged sources and review rules.

review_scope: All returned raw/protected and wrapper-stripped output, original source metadata and each original complete-proposition criterion. Root is independent of candidate/runner author.

review_criteria: Distinguish the transcript text, the transcription process and the original audio recording.
Preserve that the text was saved but the original recording was not.
Preserve that transcription is complete and translation has not started, rather than claiming that translation took 12 minutes.
Maria may remain in Latin letters or be rendered naturally as Μαρία.
Keep Eleni and Elena as two distinct people and assign each the correct role.
Nikos sent the text to Eleni; Elena was not the recipient.
Do not add an unnatural English article before a person's name.
Reasonable transliteration variants are acceptable if the people remain consistently distinguishable.
Preserve the values 12.50 euros, 2 items, 5000 sats and the explicitly rejected amount of 500 sats.
Locale-appropriate rendering such as 12,50 and 5.000 is valid if the numerical values are unchanged; literal-number flags alone are not errors.
Keep the receipt and transfer separate and retain the statement that euros and sats are different units.
Translate the ordinary English prose into Greek while allowing Bitcoin, sats and displayed receipt labels to remain as technical notation.
Preserve both scopes: denial of having said 'sold all', and the positive report that she sold none yesterday.
Do not turn 'did not sell any' into 'did not sell all', which allows some sales.
Today's possible sale remains undecided rather than certain or completed.
Judge complete propositions; merely retaining a token such as 'not' does not establish correct negation.
Giannis approves and Anna publishes; do not reverse their roles.
Approval is a necessary condition: retain 'only if', not merely a possible reason for publication.
The no-answer condition concerns Giannis, not Anna.
Retain Friday as the response deadline and Monday as the end of the waiting period.
Keep the first sentence as a quoted question with two alternatives; do not choose a count.
Retain the explicit uncertainty and the insufficiency of the title as evidence.
Do not invent an answer or convert the question into a factual statement.
